reports.title: BioCryst Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook for 2026
section: The company maintained its outlook for full year 2026 global net ORLADEYO revenue of $625 million to $645 million and increased its full year 2026 total revenue outlook, including revenue from RAPIVAB® (peramivir injection) and the licensing of navenibart European rights, to $715 million to $730 million. The increase was primarily driven by higher revenues from the licensing of navenibart rights, as well as higher RAPIVAB orders from international partners.

The company improved its outlook for full year 2026 non-GAAP operating expenses, excluding stock-based compensation, restructuring, and transaction-related costs, to $415 million to $425 million. The decrease was primarily driven by continued progress on the Birmingham site closure.

Item | As of November 4, 2026 | As of August 5, 2026
ORLADEYO revenue | Unchanged | $625 million to $645 million
Total revenue | $715 million to $730 million | $690 million to $715 million
Non-GAAP operating expense | $415 million to $425 million | $420 million to $440 million
